_comment: This tool's references, in citation order: the tool's pages number them [1], [2], ... in this order (IEEE style). Archived copies are in the source-archive release (older ones in the shared sources/ folder), listed in sources/archive.json; never commit the files themselves (see sources/README.md). Title style: 'quoted' for articles, web pages and parts of books; 'italic' for books, reports and datasets.
